headline: Tencent Q3 Revenue Growth Slows to 8% as Gaming Segment Cools
summary: Tencent Holdings reported third-quarter revenue growth of 8% year-over-year, slowing from 11% in Q2 and missing consensus expectations. Operating profit reached 59.2 billion yuan against expectations of 66.8 billion yuan.
why: Tencent is China's largest technology conglomerate by market capitalization, dominating online gaming and social messaging.

impacts.name: Tencent Holdings Limited
impacts.why: Tencent's revenue and operating income fell short of analysts' consensus estimates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Quarterly operating profit missing market forecasts pressured investor sentiment surrounding Chinese internet majors.
